scope: G4 first-batch refusal source sites; independent of guide article counts
notes: The source-site denominator counts refusal statements in the named first-batch functions, not articles, route totals, or every boolean subexpression. Pass-through validators and their deeper internals are explicit gaps; this does not claim every ERP business branch is precisely bound.
Some refusal sites invoke one shared rule binding; registered binding count and syntactic source-site count are deliberately separate.
Dedicated Store evidence does not imply browser verification. Browser evidence is reported separately.
Legacy text-return helpers retain the original message. Unknown failures are never reclassified from message text.
